defects.title: SecretsScanner silently drops hardcoded Stripe live keys: gitleaks hit is mapped to MEDIUM ('token') below the scanner's default HIGH threshold, so the report shows 0 findings
defects.expected_behavior: A hardcoded Stripe live secret key in the reviewed code is reported as a secrets finding (and triaged), like generic-api-key hits are.
defects.observed_behavior: In both rounds gitleaks matched the sk_live_ literal in submission.py (container log `Scanner completed filtered_findings=0 raw_findings=1 scanner=secrets`), SecretsScanner mapped the stripe-access-token hit to MEDIUM and dropped it below its default HIGH threshold, and every step returned 'Raw findings: 0 / After suppression filtering: 0 / Triaged findings: 0'. No LLM is called on this path. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (2fae4a7a4cdf).
